snippet.title: Soverain | Motoi Sakuraba Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
We're thrilled to reveal that legendary composer Motoi Sakuraba has joined Soverain!
Known for his work on Golden Sun, Tales of, Dark Souls, Star Ocean and many more, Sakuraba has composed an original track for the game.

This trailer also features a first look at the Japanese voice acting.

Don't hesitate to support the Kickstarter campaign, we're entering the final days!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jonathanbrassaud/eternal-legend-0
 
Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4123930/Soverain_An_Eternal_Legend/
Website: https://www.soverain-game.com

Sound Design : Alexis Schutz 
Motion Design : Franck Besançon - https://intothevoid.fr
